title: Evolve on Graph: Self-Evolving Knowledge Graph Reasoning without Question Annotations
title_zh: 图上演化：无需问题标注的自演化知识图谱推理

paragraphs.en: 提出EoG框架，通过图自博弈让LLM无需QA标注即可自演化提升知识图谱推理能力。 Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide reliable external knowledge for multi-hop factual reasoning with large language models (LLMs), yet most KGs in real-world domains such as finance and industry lack question--answer (QA) annotations. Without such annotations, existing methods struggle to improve LLM graph reasoning: training-free agents cannot improve their exploration through interaction; reinforcement learning (RL) agents depend on QA data annotated by humans or synthesized by closed-source models; and training data is typically built offline, so its topology mix is fixed and cannot follow the agent's ability. We propose Evolve on Graph (EoG), a framework that lets an LLM self-evolve its graph reasoning without any QA annotations. Through Graph Self-Play, a single LLM alternates between a Proposer that poses questions and a Solver that answers them. To make questions verifiable, Symbolically Verifiable Topology Synthesis (SVTS) samples reasoning topologies on the KG and executes the corresponding first-order logic queries, yielding topology skeletons with correct and complete answer sets; guided by a skeleton, the Proposer explores the graph to pose a multi-hop question. To let task topologies follow the Solver, a Boundary-Aware Graph Curriculum rewards the Proposer by the Solver's score variance, keeping questions at the Solver's capability boundary so that complex topologies enter training as the Solver improves. On six benchmarks over Freebase, Wikidata, and an industrial KG, EoG consistently outperforms prompting-, retrieval-, and agent-based methods, showing that LLM graph reasoning can improve through self-play without QA annotations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Szy5/EoG
paragraphs.zh: 提出EoG框架，通过图自博弈让LLM无需QA标注即可自演化提升知识图谱推理能力。知识图谱（KG）为大型语言模型（LLM）的多跳事实推理提供了可靠的外部知识，然而金融和工业等现实领域中的大多数知识图谱缺乏问答（QA）标注。 缺乏此类标注时，现有方法难以提升LLM的图推理能力：免训练的智能体无法通过交互改进其探索；强化学习（RL）智能体依赖于人工标注或闭源模型合成的QA数据；且训练数据通常离线构建，其拓扑混合是固定的，无法跟随智能体的能力。 我们提出图上演化（EoG）框架，使LLM无需任何QA标注即可自演化其图推理能力。 通过图自博弈，单个LLM在提出问题的Proposer和回答问题的Solver之间交替。 为使问题可验证，符号可验证拓扑合成（SVTS）在知识图谱上采样推理拓扑并执行相应的一阶逻辑查询，得到具有正确且完备答案集的拓扑骨架；在骨架的引导下，Proposer探索图谱以提出多跳问题。 为使任务拓扑跟随Solver，边界感知图课程以Solver的得分方差奖励Proposer，将问题保持在Solver的能力边界，从而随着Solver的提升使复杂拓扑进入训练。 在基于Freebase、Wikidata和一个工业知识图谱的六个基准上，EoG持续优于基于提示、检索和智能体的方法，表明LLM的图推理能力可以通过自博弈在没有QA标注的情况下得到提升。 我们的代码发布于 https://github.com/Szy5/EoG
